name: @hmcts/rpx-xui-core-lib
description: Shared EXUI core library: repository foundation for selective browser loading and Node services.

scripts.test: mkdir -p test-results && node scripts/check-repository.mjs && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=test-results/validation.tap tests/validation.test.mjs tests/case-sharing/state.test.mjs tests/session-storage/session-storage.test.mjs tests/task-data/task-data.test.mjs
scripts.test:node: rm -rf test-results/node-unit test-results/node.tap && tsc -p tests/node/tsconfig.json && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=test-results/node.tap test-results/node-unit/tests/node/*.spec.js && node --test tests/build-watch.test.mjs
scripts.test:i18n: node --test tests/i18n-imports.test.mjs && rm -rf test-results/i18n && playwright test -c tests/i18n/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:cache-upgrade: node --test tests/cache-upgrade-source-mismatch.test.mjs && node scripts/build-cache-upgrade.mjs && playwright test -c tests/cache-upgrade/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:all:sequence: yarn build && yarn lint && yarn test:tooling-security && yarn test:reporters && yarn test:contracts && yarn test:compatibility:contracts && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs refDataUnit test:ref-data && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs locationUnit test:locations && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs windowUnit test:window && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs cookieUnit test:cookie && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs featureToggleUnit test:feature-toggle && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs roleUnit test:roles && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs unit test && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs nodeUnit test:node && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs i18nUnit test:i18n && node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs package test:package && yarn build:host && yarn test:browser:support && PW_ODHIN_LIGHTWEIGHT=false node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs browser test:browser && PW_ODHIN_LIGHTWEIGHT=false node scripts/run-evidence-lane.mjs cacheBrowser test:cache-upgrade && yarn check:contracts && node tests/reporters/odhin-site-publisher.cjs --check-source test-results/odhin && node tests/reporters/browser-check.cjs test-results/odhin/browser/index.html && node tests/reporters/browser-check.cjs test-results/odhin/cache-upgrade/index.html
